question: Should ClawHub add a first-class SKILL.md capability manifest for skills, and what schema, authority model, and advisory-to-required rollout should it use?
rationale: This defines a public trust boundary for uploaded skills; automation can verify it is not implemented, but cannot choose the permanent schema or rollout policy safely.

options.title: Adopt Advisory Manifest First
options.body: Define the schema in specs, parse and expose it as advisory metadata, and use ClawScan to flag declared-versus-observed mismatches before making it required.

options.title: Defer To Scanner Inference
options.body: Continue relying on env/install metadata plus ClawScan coherence checks, accepting that authors still have no broad declared baseline for network, filesystem, execution, or secret access.

options.title: Require Manifests Immediately
options.body: Make new submissions include the capability block from day one, which strengthens the contract but requires a sharper legacy and false-positive policy before launch.

recommendation.title: Adopt Advisory Manifest First
recommendation.body: Define the schema in specs, parse and expose it as advisory metadata, and use ClawScan to flag declared-versus-observed mismatches before making it required.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to CODEOWNERS and blame for the schema, parser, ClawScan prompt, and security-doc surfaces where the decision would land.
